text:
Matthew Wood is now a Seattle Kraken. Nashville's 2023 first-round pick moved to Seattle after 91 games as a Predator and has eight games with his new team, where the club's own coverage says he's finding his footing. Across both stops he has seven points in 22 games, four of them on the power play, playing about 13 and a half minutes a night.

The goals are the thing that will change. Wood has one goal on 4.1 expected, shooting 3% on 33 shots. He scored 17 goals in his first 77 NHL games, and goals tend to follow chances like these.

The rest of the picture is ordinary for a 21-year-old: his teams have trailed in shot share at five on five with him on the ice, about the same as when he sits. Evolving-Hockey liked his rookie year more than the raw numbers suggested (1.4 wins above replacement, mostly from even-strength offense), and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him setting up teammates at an 83rd-percentile rate. A fresh start and more minutes in Seattle are what to watch. His recent ice time has dipped to about 12 and a half.
headline: Wood starts over in Seattle
